title: 1993 Topps Stadium Club - Members Only #241 John Elway
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1993 Topps Stadium Club sports trading card features John Elway, the legendary quarterback for the Denver Broncos. The card is from the Members Only parallel/variety set and is numbered 241. It is a great addition to any collection for fans of football and the National Football League (NFL). 

The card is in excellent shape and has not been autographed. It is a base set card with no major flaws. The card number is 241 and it is from the 1993 season. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and sought-after card.
